integrations_github_account_description: Connect a GitHub account so Agents can work with its repositories.
integrations_github_connection_changed: GitHub connection changed. Review its current status.
integrations_github_error_authentication: Sign in and connect GitHub again.
integrations_github_error_conflict: The connection changed. Reload and try again.
integrations_github_error_flow_expired: The GitHub authorization expired. Try again.
integrations_github_error_flow_invalid: The GitHub authorization could not be completed. Try again.
integrations_github_error_generic: The GitHub request could not be completed.
integrations_github_error_identity_misma: That authorization returned a different GitHub account. Use a different account to replace it.
integrations_github_error_rate_limited: GitHub rate limit reached. Try again shortly.
integrations_github_error_state: The GitHub connection does not support this action right now.
integrations_github_error_token_lifetime: The GitHub App must issue expiring user tokens. Ask an administrator to enable them.
integrations_github_error_upstream: GitHub is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
integrations_github_install_description: Choose repositories in GitHub when installing the App, then refresh here to update the installation list.
integrations_github_installations_descri: Installations of the OpenTag GitHub App this account can use.
integrations_github_pending_description: The GitHub authorization was started but not finished.
integrations_github_reauth_description: GitHub authorization expired or was revoked. Reconnect to keep using these repositories.
integrations_github_unavailable_descript: This deployment has no GitHub App configured. An administrator must add one before Accounts can connect.
